visual.general_description: Six axial contrast-enhanced upper-abdominal CT images in two rows of three, arranged in time order a to f, with liver lesions conspicuous in the first panels and progressively fainter or fewer in later panels.
visual.detailed_description: Top row panels a, b and c and bottom row panels d, e and f show grayscale axial CT sections through the liver, spine, aorta, stomach and spleen. Panels a and b show several rounded low-density liver lesions. Panel c shows fainter lesions and a dark low-density stomach lumen. Panel d shows one distinct small low-density focus in the lower part of the liver, panel e only a few small faint foci and panel f shows an essentially uniform liver. Panel a has a small tick-mark ruler at its right edge. White lowercase panel letters are printed at the top left of each panel. No dates, names or measurements are printed in the image.
